description: This Java class 'DataVolume' defines the data volume limits for tenant resource management in an Eclipse Hono-based project. It includes properties for effective timestamp, maximum bytes, and period, with getters, setters, and fluent API support.

classes.name: DataVolume
classes.description: Represents data volume limits and related metadata for tenants.

methods.name: getEffectiveSince
methods.description: Returns the point in time when the data volume limit became effective.

methods.name: setEffectiveSince
methods.description: Sets the effective timestamp for the data volume limit, following ISO offset date-time format.

methods.name: getMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed bytes for the data volume.

methods.name: setMaxBytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes allowed, throws IllegalArgumentException if less than -1.

methods.name: getPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period over which data usage is calculated.

methods.name: setPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period for data usage calculation.
